name: MinerU2.5-Pro-2604-1.2B

lineage.how_derived: data engineering: corpus grown from under 10M to 65.5M pages, hard-sample fine-tuning, GRPO format alignment

purpose: PDF-to-Markdown conversion for LLM data pipelines and RAG; also images, charts and in-table images.

license.name: Apache-2.0 (model card tag); MinerU code repo: Apache-2.0 plus additional terms
license.notes: Model repo has no LICENSE file (card tag apache-2.0). The MinerU GitHub LICENSE.md read says Apache-2.0 plus: separate commercial license needed above 100M monthly active users or 20M USD monthly revenue; online services based on MinerU must display that MinerU is used; breach terminates the license. Irrelevant at our scale, but binding if we ship the pipeline as a service.

architecture.why_this_design: Gains came from data and training recipe, not from a larger architecture (card).

engine_support.notes: recommended path is vLLM; GGUF only community

benchmarks.name: Dr.DocBench overall (as listed in another vendor's card)

strengths: mature pipeline project with large user base
weaknesses: cross-page table merging not yet integrated
Chinese and English only on the card
MDPBench: strong on digital pages (86.2) but drops on photographed ones (66.1)
best_for: batch PDF to Markdown for retrieval
soft.maturity: MinerU is an established open-source project with frequent releases

tona_fit.reason: good digital-page parser, German 78.3 on third-party pages, but photographed pages drop and its normal path is a Python pipeline; PaddleOCR-VL and GLM-OCR score higher on German with simpler deployment

sources.note: MDPBench README table read directly; an earlier summarizer pass mislabeled the Latin-average column as DE, the DE values here come from the dataset README

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 about 2 GB; Tona runs one model at a time, so it replaces the resident model while it works
